title: Themes
description: Theming support in Huba.

Huba supports theming, allowing you to personalize the look and feel of your terminal interface. The app ships with 5 built-in themes and lets you create your own custom themes.

## Switching Themes

Use the following keyboard shortcuts to cycle through available themes:

- `w` — cycle to next theme
- `Shift+W` — cycle to previous theme

Your theme preference is persisted across sessions automatically.

- **[Built-in Themes](/docs/themes/built-in-themes)** — explore the themes that ship with Huba
- **[Custom Themes](/docs/themes/custom-themes)** — create and share your own themes
